_comment: DEF200 — async handlers the census flags as reaching sync I/O. Frozen 2026-08-18 (AT:R70) at 87 so a ratchet could ship green over pre-existing debt; swept 2026-08-25 (AT:R74) from 86 to 38 by converting every handler that never awaited anything to a plain `def`, which Starlette runs in a threadpool. This list is meant to SHRINK. Remove an entry when its handler is converted; do not add one to get a build past the guard. READ `total_async_handlers_when_frozen` TOGETHER WITH THIS: the flagged count is a subset of the scanned population, and the vacuity guard watches the population, not the subset — otherwise finishing the work would break the guard that protects it.
